title: Mkpụrụ Obi Dị Nwayọọ n'etiti Ndị Amụma
intro: Olu na-akpọku ezi omume na-ada ụda site na amaokwu nke Quran dị nsọ. E nyere mkpụrụ obi a dị ngọzi amụma na akwụkwọ nsọ n'oge a chọrọ nduzi nke ukwuu n'etiti ụmụ Izrel. Onye a gwara ndị ha okwu ozugbo, na-agba ha ume ka ha cheta Onyenwe ha. Site na ndidi na nraranye, ha ghọrọ ìhè nke akụkọ ya na-eme ka peeji nke akwụkwọ nsọ dị nsọ pụta ìhè. Ị nwere ike ịchọpụta onye a pụrụ iche nke aha ya dị nsọ ma na Quran ma na Oziọma?
clues: E nyere m nsọpụrụ site n'ịbụ onye amụma na akwụkwọ eluigwe n'oge mkpa nke ndị m.
Nne m mụrụ m n'ụzọ dị ịtụnanya, site na iwu Chineke nke Chineke.
Agwara m ndị m okwu, sị, 'Ụmụ Izrel! Abụ m onye ozi Chineke nye unu, na-akwado ihe dị n'ihu m.'
Abịara m na ihe ịrịba ama doro anya sitere n'aka Onyenwe unu, na-ewetara m ozi ọma nke onye amụma aha ya bụ Ahmad.
Nne m bụ nwanyị ezi omume nke raara m nye n'ọrụ Allah site na nwata m.
Allah kụziiri m Quran ma mee ka m nwee ọmịiko na nsọpụrụ n'ebe nne m nọ, abụghịkwa m onye mpako ma ọ bụ onye na-enupụ isi.

trial.answer: E kwuru okwu n'ime nwa mgbe ọ bụ nwata

options: E wegara ya n'eluigwe n'anụ ahụ
A nwalere m ọrịa ekpenta ruo ọtụtụ afọ

outcome.answer: E wegara ya n'eluigwe n'anụ ahụ

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرًۢا بِرَسُولٍۢ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِى ٱسْمُهُۥٓ أَحْمَدُ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verse: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O Children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allāh to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Aḥmad." But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic." (61:6)
